label: hAP lite
description: MikroTik hAP lite (RB941-2nD) — 4x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz. SMIPS 1-core QCA9533.
notes: No PoE on any socket. https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/hap-lite/ (read 2026-11-28): "The device accepts power in the following ways: microUSB accepts 5 V DC. The power consumption under maximum load can reach 5 W." - one microUSB inlet and no PoE line anywhere in the guide (it gives 5 W under maximum load where the product page gives 3.5 W; neither figure is a PoE draw, so neither is a declared inlet). https://mikrotik.com/product/RB941-2nD: Number of DC inputs 1 (MicroUSB), Max power consumption 3.5 W, and no PoE in or PoE out row. Every copper socket is poeIn: false, which stops the wireless-class guess from claiming 12.95 W on each of the four Fast Ethernet ports of a 3.5 W USB-powered AP.
